changelog: **One registry and one runner for the deploy's data migrations (#1540):** the 28 seeds/backfills that `infra/deploy-prod.sh` ran as hand-listed `run_tool node … || true` lines now live, in the same order, in `prisma/backfills/registry.mjs` (`{ id, script, args, once, optional, why, failNote }`) and run through `prisma/run-backfills.mjs`, which records every outcome in the new `BackfillRun` ledger (infrastructure: no `orgId`, not in `TENANT_MODELS`), skips a `once` entry after its first success (the cron baseline and the three plan grandfathers), stops the deploy when a non-optional entry fails and ends with `backfills: N registered, N ran ok, N skipped (once), N failed`. Every entry is `optional` with its reason today — that was the `|| true` — so the change is visibility, not new failure modes; making one required is now a one-field edit. The schema-bracketing steps (`backfill-company-interest-scope`, `backfill-setting-id`, both `backfill-json-columns --repair`) stay around the push, and the read-only reports run after the backfills. **Fixes #1385 for real:** `scripts/backfill-requisitions.mjs` and `scripts/backfill-applications.mjs` were never in the runtime image (only `prisma/` is copied), so their deploy lines failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on every deploy behind `|| true`; the Dockerfile now copies them and their libs. `scripts/test/backfill-registry.test.mjs` pins the ids, the image contents, the ordering constraints (tenant attribution before `backfill-organization`, `api-key-lifecycle` after it, skill-lists before skill-taxonomy) and that `deploy-prod.sh` runs no backfill directly.
